quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: At a hospital you have been kept waiting much longer than expected with no information given.
quests.correctAnswer: Ask the reception desk for an update
quests.hint: Approach the desk calmly: 'Could you tell me approximately how long the wait will be? I have been here two hours.'
quests.explanation: Asking for information politely is your right. Medical staff will tell you what they can.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: At a hospital you have been kept waiting much longer than expected with no information given.
quests.correctAnswer: Explain if your condition is worsening
quests.hint: If you feel worse tell the staff immediately: 'I need to let you know my symptoms have changed.'
quests.explanation: Medical staff prioritise based on clinical need. Communicating changes is essential.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: At a hospital you have been kept waiting much longer than expected with no information given.
quests.correctAnswer: Remain patient but advocate for yourself
quests.hint: Say: 'I understand you are busy. I just want to make sure I have not been overlooked. Could someone check for me?'
quests.explanation: Polite self-advocacy in medical settings ensures you receive the care you need without creating conflict.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Your manager assigns you extra work without asking beyond your normal role.
quests.correctAnswer: Discuss your current workload before accepting
quests.hint: Say: 'I want to help with this. Could we look at my current tasks and decide what should take priority?'
quests.explanation: Negotiating priorities instead of just accepting extra work prevents burnout and missed deadlines.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Your manager assigns you extra work without asking beyond your normal role.
quests.correctAnswer: Ask if this is a permanent or temporary change
quests.hint: Ask: 'Is this a one-time project or will this be part of my regular responsibilities?' This clarifies expectations.
quests.explanation: Understanding the scope of new work helps you plan and decide whether to negotiate further.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Your manager assigns you extra work without asking beyond your normal role.
quests.correctAnswer: Document the additional work for future discussions
quests.hint: Keep a record of the extra tasks and time spent. This is useful evidence in performance or pay reviews.
quests.explanation: Documenting out-of-scope work supports future conversations about role boundaries or compensation.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Two departments in your company blame each other for a failed project.
quests.correctAnswer: Facilitate a joint meeting focused on lessons learned
quests.hint: Suggest: 'Instead of focusing on blame can we look at what went wrong and how we fix it together?'
quests.explanation: Shifting from blame to learning converts a conflict into an improvement opportunity.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Two departments in your company blame each other for a failed project.
quests.correctAnswer: Start with what everyone agrees on
quests.hint: Begin by identifying shared facts: 'We all agree the deadline was missed. Let us look at the timeline together.'
quests.explanation: Starting with points of agreement provides common ground before exploring differences.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Two departments in your company blame each other for a failed project.
quests.correctAnswer: Propose a process review rather than a blame review
quests.hint: Suggest a structured review that examines processes not people: 'What systems failed us?'
quests.explanation: Process-focused reviews are less threatening than individual blame and lead to better systemic solutions.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: You need to ask your neighbour to stop parking in your allocated space.
quests.correctAnswer: Introduce yourself and explain clearly
quests.hint: Say: 'Hi I am from flat 4. I think this space is allocated to me - could you park in the general area instead?'
quests.explanation: Introducing yourself humanises the request and makes a positive relationship more likely.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: You need to ask your neighbour to stop parking in your allocated space.
quests.correctAnswer: Leave a polite note if they are not home
quests.hint: Write: 'Hi neighbour - this space belongs to flat 4. Grateful if you could use the general area. Thanks!'
quests.explanation: A friendly note resolves the issue while maintaining a positive neighbour relationship.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: You need to ask your neighbour to stop parking in your allocated space.
quests.correctAnswer: Contact the building manager if it continues
quests.hint: If polite requests do not work contact building management with your tenancy agreement as proof.
quests.explanation: Escalating with documentary evidence resolves disputes about allocated resources effectively.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: A friend wants to borrow a significant amount of money from you.
quests.correctAnswer: Think carefully before agreeing
quests.hint: Ask yourself: Can I afford to lose this money? Would it affect our friendship if repayment became complicated?
quests.explanation: Careful reflection before lending money prevents both financial and relationship problems.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: A friend wants to borrow a significant amount of money from you.
quests.correctAnswer: Be honest if you are not comfortable lending
quests.hint: It is okay to say: 'I am not in a position to lend money right now but let us see how else I can help.'
quests.explanation: Honest declination of financial requests is more respectful than a false promise.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: A friend wants to borrow a significant amount of money from you.
quests.correctAnswer: If you lend put the terms in writing
quests.hint: A simple written agreement specifying the amount and repayment plan protects both the money and the friendship.
quests.explanation: Written agreements for significant loans remove ambiguity and prevent future conflict.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: A colleague makes an offensive joke in the office and everyone laughs nervously.
quests.correctAnswer: Respond calmly: 'I do not think that kind of humour works for everyone here.'
quests.hint: A calm factual response draws a clear line without attacking the person personally.
quests.explanation: Addressing inappropriate workplace humour directly but calmly sets a professional standard.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: A colleague makes an offensive joke in the office and everyone laughs nervously.
quests.correctAnswer: Speak to them privately afterwards
quests.hint: Say: 'I wanted to mention - that joke earlier made some people uncomfortable. I thought you would want to know.'
quests.explanation: Private feedback on behaviour is more likely to be heard without defensiveness than public correction.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: A colleague makes an offensive joke in the office and everyone laughs nervously.
quests.correctAnswer: Report it to HR if it continues or is serious
quests.hint: Repeated or seriously offensive behaviour should be reported formally to protect all employees.
quests.explanation: Knowing when to formally report workplace behaviour is an important professional responsibility.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Your teenager repeatedly comes home later than their agreed curfew.
quests.correctAnswer: Have a calm non-accusatory conversation about it
quests.hint: Say: 'I have noticed you have come home late a few times. I want to understand why before we talk about consequences.'
quests.explanation: Understanding the reason before imposing consequences leads to more effective parenting conversations.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Your teenager repeatedly comes home later than their agreed curfew.
quests.correctAnswer: Revisit whether the curfew is realistic
quests.hint: Ask: 'Do you think the current time is realistic? Let us look at what would work for both of us.'
quests.explanation: Collaborative rule-making with teenagers builds respect and increases the chance of compliance.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Your teenager repeatedly comes home later than their agreed curfew.
quests.correctAnswer: Agree on specific consequences for future breaches
quests.hint: Together agree clearly: 'If this happens again here is what will change.' Then follow through.
quests.explanation: Clear pre-agreed consequences make enforcement less emotional and more effective.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: At a job interview you are asked an unexpected question you do not know how to answer.
quests.correctAnswer: Pause then think out loud
quests.hint: Say: 'That is a great question. Let me think through that for a moment...' then speak through your reasoning.
quests.explanation: Thinking aloud shows the interviewer your reasoning process which is often more valuable than the answer itself.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: At a job interview you are asked an unexpected question you do not know how to answer.
quests.correctAnswer: Admit you are not sure and explain your approach
quests.hint: Say: 'I do not have direct experience with that but here is how I would approach it...'
quests.explanation: Honesty about knowledge gaps combined with problem-solving ability makes a strong impression.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: At a job interview you are asked an unexpected question you do not know how to answer.
quests.correctAnswer: Ask a clarifying question to buy time
quests.hint: Say: 'Could you tell me a bit more about the context? That will help me give you a more useful answer.'
quests.explanation: Clarifying questions show engagement and give you time to gather your thoughts.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: You are in a business negotiation and the other party makes an offer that is far too low.
quests.correctAnswer: Stay calm and counter with a clear number
quests.hint: Say: 'I appreciate the offer. Based on the scope of the work I was thinking more along the lines of [figure].'
quests.explanation: A clear confident counter-offer is the standard professional response to a low initial offer.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: You are in a business negotiation and the other party makes an offer that is far too low.
quests.correctAnswer: Ask what is driving their number
quests.hint: 'Help me understand your thinking on that figure. What constraints are you working with?'
quests.explanation: Understanding the other party's constraints often reveals room for creative solutions.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: You are in a business negotiation and the other party makes an offer that is far too low.
quests.correctAnswer: Highlight the value you bring before countering
quests.hint: Before countering briefly summarise your key value points then introduce your number.
quests.explanation: Anchoring your counter-offer in value makes it feel justified rather than arbitrary.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: You notice a close friend showing signs of depression but they have not said anything.
quests.correctAnswer: Reach out with a simple genuine message
quests.hint: Text: 'Hey I have been thinking about you. How are you actually doing?' The word 'actually' invites honesty.
quests.explanation: A simple caring message opens the door without pressure and shows your friend they are not alone.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: You notice a close friend showing signs of depression but they have not said anything.
quests.correctAnswer: Spend time with them without pressure to talk
quests.hint: Invite them: 'I am going for a coffee - fancy coming along?' Time together does not require deep conversation.
quests.explanation: Presence without pressure is one of the most supportive things you can offer someone who is struggling.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: You notice a close friend showing signs of depression but they have not said anything.
quests.correctAnswer: Gently mention professional support if the time is right
quests.hint: You might say: 'Have you thought about talking to someone? There are good people who can help.'
quests.explanation: Suggesting professional help is appropriate when someone shows ongoing signs of distress.
